name: Mariners Sailors
overview: Scripture portrays mariners and sailors as those who venture into great waters for commerce and travel, facing both natural dangers and spiritual challenges. Psalms 107:23 acknowledges their trade on the seas, while Isaiah 42:10 calls all who go down to the sea to praise the Lord, highlighting God's sovereignty over the oceans. The perilous nature of their work is evident in Acts 27, where sailors take measures to save their ship from quicksands and fear for their lives, and Jonah 1:5 depicts their fear and desperate prayers during a storm. Additionally, Ezekiel 27:27 warns of the ultimate downfall of mariners and their vessels in judgment, and Acts 27:30 reveals moments of cowardice as some sailors attempt to abandon ship in crisis.
